verses.original: Κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί ἦλθον οὐ καθ’ ὑπεροχὴν λόγου ἢ σοφίας καταγγέλλων ὑμῖν τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kagō elthōn pros hymas adelphoi ēlthon ou kath’ hyperochēn logou ē sophias katangellōn hymin to martyrion tou Theou
verses.literal: When I came to you brothers I did not come with eloquence . . . or wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God
verses.literalPt: Eu, quando fui ter convosco, irmãos, fui não com excelência de palavras ou de sabedoria, anunciando-vos o testemunho de Deus.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔκρινά τι εἰδέναι ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μὴ Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν καὶ τοῦτον ἐσταυρωμένον
verses.transliteration: ou gar ekrina ti eidenai en hymin ei mē Iēsoun Christon kai touton estaurōmenon
verses.literal: For I resolved to know nothing . . . while I was with you except . . . Jesus Christ and Him crucified
verses.literalPt: Pois resolvi não saber coisa alguma entre vós, senão a Jesus Cristo, e este crucificado.

verses.original: κἀγὼ ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ καὶ ἐν φόβῳ καὶ ἐν τρόμῳ πολλῷ ἐγενόμην πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kagō en astheneia kai en phobō kai en tromō pollō egenomēn pros hymas
verses.literal: I came to you in weakness and fear and with much trembling
verses.literalPt: Eu estive entre vós em fraqueza, em temor e em grande tremor;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ λόγος μου καὶ τὸ κήρυγμά μου οὐκ ἐν πειθοῖς σοφίας λόγοις ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀποδείξει Πνεύματος καὶ δυνάμεως
verses.transliteration: kai ho logos mou kai to kērygma mou ouk en peithois sophias logois all’ en apodeixei Pneumatos kai dynameōs
verses.literal: My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power
verses.literalPt: e o meu ensino e a minha pregação não foram em palavras persuasivas de sabedoria, mas em demonstração do Espírito e do poder,

verses.original: ἵνα ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν μὴ ᾖ ἐν σοφίᾳ ἀνθρώπων ἀλλ’ ἐν δυνάμει Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina hē pistis hymōn mē ē en sophia anthrōpōn all’ en dynamei Theou
verses.literal: so that your faith would not rest on men’s wisdom but on God’s power
verses.literalPt: para que a vossa fé não se baseie na sabedoria dos homens, mas no poder de Deus.

verses.original: Σοφίαν δὲ λαλοῦμεν ἐν τοῖς τελείοις σοφίαν δὲ οὐ τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου οὐδὲ τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου τῶν καταργουμένων
verses.transliteration: Sophian de laloumen en tois teleiois sophian de ou tou aiōnos toutou oude tōn archontōn tou aiōnos toutou tōn katargoumenōn
verses.literal: Among the mature however we speak a message of wisdom but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age who are coming to nothing
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, falamos sabedoria entre os perfeitos, porém não a sabedoria deste mundo, nem a dos poderosos deste mundo, que estão sendo reduzidos a nada;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λαλοῦμεν Θεοῦ σοφίαν ἐν μυστηρίῳ τὴν ἀποκεκρυμμένην ἣν προώρισεν ὁ Θεὸς πρὸ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς δόξαν ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: alla laloumen Theou sophian en mystēriō tēn apokekrymmenēn hēn proōrisen ho Theos pro tōn aiōnōn eis doxan hēmōn
verses.literal: No we speak of the mysterious and hidden wisdom of God which He destined for our glory before time began
verses.literalPt: pelo contrário, falamos a sabedoria de Deus em mistério, sim, a sabedoria que esteve oculta, a qual Deus predeterminou antes dos séculos para a nossa glória;

verses.original: ἣν οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἔγνωκεν εἰ γὰρ ἔγνωσαν οὐκ ἂν τὸν Κύριον τῆς δόξης ἐσταύρωσαν
verses.transliteration: hēn oudeis tōn archontōn tou aiōnos toutou egnōken ei gar egnōsan ouk an ton Kyrion tēs doxēs estaurōsan
verses.literal: None of the rulers of this age understood it For if they had they would not have crucified the Lord of glory
verses.literalPt: a qual nenhum dos poderosos deste mundo conheceu, pois, se a tivessem conhecido, não teriam crucificado o Senhor da glória;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Ἃ ὀφθαλμὸς οὐκ εἶδεν καὶ οὖς οὐκ ἤκουσεν καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἀνέβη ὅσα ἡτοίμασεν ὁ Θεὸς τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alla kathōs gegraptai Ha ophthalmos ouk eiden kai ous ouk ēkousen kai epi kardian anthrōpou ouk anebē hosa hētoimasen ho Theos tois agapōsin auton
verses.literal: Rather as it is written No eye has seen no ear has heard no heart has imagined . . . . . . what God has prepared for those who love Him
verses.literalPt: mas como está escrito: As coisas que o olho não viu, e o ouvido não ouviu, e não entraram no coração do homem, tudo quanto preparou Deus para os que o amam.

verses.original: Ἡμῖν γὰρ ἀπεκάλυψεν ὁ Θεὸς διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος Τὸ γὰρ Πνεῦμα πάντα ἐραυνᾷ καὶ τὰ βάθη τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hēmin gar apekalypsen ho Theos dia tou Pneumatos To gar Pneuma panta erauna kai ta bathē tou Theou
verses.literal: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit The Spirit searches all things even the deep things of God
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus no-las revelou a nós pelo Espírito; porque o Espírito tudo esquadrinha, até as coisas profundas de Deus.

verses.original: τίς γὰρ οἶδεν ἀνθρώπων τὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰ μὴ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τὸ ἐν αὐτῷ οὕτως καὶ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐδεὶς ἔγνωκεν εἰ μὴ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: tis gar oiden anthrōpōn ta tou anthrōpou ei mē to pneuma tou anthrōpou to en autō houtōs kai ta tou Theou oudeis egnōken ei mē to Pneuma tou Theou
verses.literal: For who among men knows the thoughts of man except . . . his own spirit within him So too no one knows the thoughts of God except . . . the Spirit of God
verses.literalPt: Qual dos homens sabe as coisas do homem, senão o espírito do homem, que nele está? Assim, também as coisas de Deus, ninguém as conhece, senão o Espírito de Deus.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ κόσμου ἐλάβομεν ἀλλὰ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα εἰδῶμεν τὰ ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ χαρισθέντα ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de ou to pneuma tou kosmou elabomen alla to pneuma to ek tou Theou hina eidōmen ta hypo tou Theou charisthenta hēmin
verses.literal: We have not received . . . the spirit of the world but the Spirit who is from God that we may understand what - God has freely given us
verses.literalPt: Nós não recebemos o espírito do mundo, mas sim o espírito que vem de Deus, para que saibamos as coisas que por Deus nos foram dadas gratuitamente;

verses.original: ἃ καὶ λαλοῦμεν οὐκ ἐν διδακτοῖς ἀνθρωπίνης σοφίας λόγοις ἀλλ’ ἐν διδακτοῖς Πνεύματος πνευματικοῖς πνευματικὰ συνκρίνοντες
verses.transliteration: ha kai laloumen ouk en didaktois anthrōpinēs sophias logois all’ en didaktois Pneumatos pneumatikois pneumatika synkrinontes
verses.literal: And this is what we speak not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words
verses.literalPt: as quais também anunciamos, não com palavras ensinadas pela sabedoria humana, mas com palavras ensinadas pelo Espírito, combinando coisas espirituais com espirituais.

verses.original: Ψυχικὸς δὲ ἄνθρωπος οὐ δέχεται τὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Θεοῦ μωρία γὰρ αὐτῷ ἐστίν καὶ οὐ δύναται γνῶναι ὅτι πνευματικῶς ἀνακρίνεται
verses.transliteration: Psychikos de anthrōpos ou dechetai ta tou Pneumatos tou Theou mōria gar autō estin kai ou dynatai gnōnai hoti pneumatikōs anakrinetai
verses.literal: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God For they are foolishness to him and he cannot understand them because they are spiritually discerned
verses.literalPt: O homem natural não aceita as coisas do Espírito de Deus, pois para ele são loucura; não as pode conhecer, porque são julgadas espiritualmente.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ πνευματικὸς ἀνακρίνει τὰ πάντα αὐτὸς δὲ ὑπ’ οὐδενὸς ἀνακρίνεται
verses.transliteration: ho de pneumatikos anakrinei ta panta autos de hyp’ oudenos anakrinetai
verses.literal: The spiritual man judges all things but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém o homem espiritual julga todas as coisas e ele não é julgado por ninguém.

verses.original: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν Κυρίου ὃς συμβιβάσει αὐτόν ἡμεῖς δὲ νοῦν Χριστοῦ ἔχομεν
verses.transliteration: Tis gar egnō noun Kyriou hos symbibasei auton hēmeis de noun Christou echomen
verses.literal: For who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct Him But we have the mind of Christ
verses.literalPt: Pois quem conheceu a mente do Senhor, para que o possa instruir? Nós, porém, temos a mente de Cristo.
